title: OMEGA Manifest
description: Schema for safe self-modification manifest updates in Jules's OMEGA Architect.

author.description: Author of the modification (system or human identifier).

changes.description: List of file changes with checksums.

file_path.description: Absolute or relative path to modified/new file.

change_type.description: Type of change applied to the file.

checksum_before.description: SHA-256 hash of file content before change.

checksum_after.description: SHA-256 hash of file content after change.

safety_flags.description: Safety flags indicating risk level of changes.

core_change.description: True if changes affect core/ modules.

dependency_change.description: True if dependencies (requirements, packages) are changed.

model_update.description: True if ML model weights or architecture are updated.

approval_level.description: Required approval level: system-only for non-core; human-required for core.
